text:
tara: quick: noticed two broken anchors and one misleading SDK snippet in Dedicated provisioning docs (autoscale section). opening a cleanup PR now. ben: ugh, which snippet? alex: doc shows `cooldown: 30` with no units. our v2 JS/TS SDK takes milliseconds. tara: that's the one. i'll update to use `cooldownMs: 30000` and add a migration note showing the older `cooldown: 30s`/`cooldown: 30` examples. docs-bot: PR created https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7905 labels: docs, fix, ci-test. mike: please add a tiny YAML snippet that CI can validate with `yarn gen:docs` so anchors are checked. tara: adding this snippet to the PR body:

``
scalePolicy:
  type: autoscale
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 6
  cooldownMs: 30000  # v2 SDKs expect ms; older examples used seconds
  targetUtilization: 0.7
isolation:
  decorator: tenant-prefer
```

ben: also update TOC anchors: `#isolation-decorator` and `#eviction-behavior` were missing. add small changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md. alex: add a PR test step: `yarn gen:docs && grep -n "isolation-decorator" site/_build || exit 1` so maintainers can smoke-test. tara: done, pinged @mike and @ben for review. mike: i'll review wording around SLA overlap. ben: after merge, open follow-up to sync sample repos that embed the broken snippet. tara: agreed. plan: merge after reviews + green CI, revert if smoke tests fail. thanks everyone!
